title: Mycobacterial peptidyl prolyl isomerase A activates STING-TBK1-IRF3 signaling to promote IFNbeta release in macrophages.
authors: Sharma, Arun Kumar; Mal, Soumya; Sahu, Sanjaya Kumar; Bagchi, Shreya; Majumder, Debayan; Chakravorty, Debangana; Saha, Sudipto; Kundu, Manikuntala; Basu, Joyoti
one_liner_zh: 该文研究结核分枝杆菌PPiA蛋白与宿主STING蛋白的互作及免疫信号激活，虽含蛋白-蛋白对接分析，但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Peptidyl prolyl isomerases (PPIases) are well-conserved protein-folding enzymes that moonlight as regulators of bacterial virulence. Peptidyl prolyl isomerase A, PPiA (Rv0009) is a secretory protein of Mycobacterium tuberculosis that possesses sequence and structural similarity to eukaryotic cyclophilins. In this study, we validated the interaction of PPiA with stimulator of interferon genes (STING) using both, Escherichia coli-based and mammalian in vitro expression systems. In vitro pull-down assays confirmed that the cytosolic domain of STING interacts with PPiA, and moreover, we found that PPiA could induce dimerization of STING in macrophages. In silico docking analyses suggested that the PXXP (PDP) motif of PPiA is crucial for interaction with STING, and concordantly, mutations in the PDP domain (PPiA MUT-II) abrogated this interaction, as well as the ability of PPiA to facilitate STING dimerization. In agreement with these observations, fluorescence microscopy demonstrated that STING and wild-type PPiA, but not PPiA MUT-II, could colocalize when expressed in HEK293 cells. Highlighting the importance of the PDP domain further, PPiA, but not PPiA MUT-II could activate Tank binding kinase 1 (TBK1)-interferon regulatory factor 3 (IRF3) signaling to promote the release of interferon-beta (IFNbeta). PPiA, but not PPiA MUT-II expressed in Mycobacterium smegmatis induced IFNbeta release and facilitated bacterial survival in macrophages in a STING-dependent manner. The PPiA-induced release of IFNbeta was c-GAS independent. We conclude that PPiA is a previously undescribed mycobacterial regulator of STING-dependent type I interferon production from macrophages.
abstract_zh: 肽基脯氨酰异构酶（PPIases）是高度保守的蛋白质折叠酶，兼作细菌毒力的调节因子。肽基脯氨酰异构酶A，PPiA（Rv0009）是结核分枝杆菌的一种分泌蛋白，与真核亲环蛋白具有序列和结构相似性。在本研究中，我们利用基于大肠杆菌和哺乳动物的体外表达系统，验证了PPiA与干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）的相互作用。体外pull-down实验证实，STING的胞质结构域与PPiA相互作用，此外，我们发现PPiA能在巨噬细胞中诱导STING的二聚化。计算机模拟对接分析表明，PPiA的PXXP（PDP）基序对与STING的相互作用至关重要，相应地，PDP结构域中的突变（PPiA MUT-II）消除了这种相互作用，以及PPiA促进STING二聚化的能力。与这些观察结果一致，荧光显微镜显示，在HEK293细胞中表达时，STING与野生型PPiA能够共定位，而PPiA MUT-II则不能。进一步凸显PDP结构域的重要性，PPiA（而非PPiA MUT-II）能激活Tank结合激酶1（TBK1）-干扰素调节因子3（IRF3）信号通路，以促进干扰素-β（IFNbeta）的释放。在耻垢分枝杆菌中表达的PPiA（而非PPiA MUT-II）以STING依赖性方式诱导IFNbeta释放，并促进细菌在巨噬细胞中的存活。PPiA诱导的IFNbeta释放不依赖于c-GAS。我们得出结论，PPiA是先前未描述的、以STING依赖性方式调节巨噬细胞产生I型干扰素的分枝杆菌调节因子。
